Default on a square screen: the time over CPU and GPU, centred and kept inside the round edge, in place of five readings with an empty middle. A square shows one to three readings.

Default on small screens: where its usual layout would draw text too small to read at the desk, it uses the square-screen layout laid out on the rectangle, the time over CPU and GPU with the rail between.
Default sizes its text by the screen's real size, never below the legible size at the desk. On less glass a reading gives way from the end of the list, never the time.
Default: the time keeps a clear gap from the rail under it on every size.
